authoredFrom: ER-D38, from the FULL-corpus chunked dual lens. The last 55 disagreements were all analyzer-only edges in grammar-damaged files, and all of them were fabrications. The shape is wx's api_gen code-generation markup (`<<EXPORT:SortItems sortItems/2 SortItems:EXPORT>>`), which the Erlang grammar cannot read: wxListCtrl.erl returns 32 top-level ERROR nodes, loose call/atom/ann_type fragments between them, and not one fun_decl. What made the analyzer start deriving from the wreckage was an earlier fix in this same wave — ER-D32's file-path fallback for currentSource — which removed the only thing that had been stopping it (an undefined source). A fix can open a hole as easily as close one, and the fix did not come with a boundary. 12 files corpus-wide are in this state.
